pros: Risk settings before the first trade.
A browser dashboard - nothing to install.
redFlags: No regulator, licence or audit named anywhere.
Marketing numbers the fine print quietly qualifies.
A support bullet that garbles two claims at once.

faqs.a: Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: Is Tesla Stock Trade safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: Where is Tesla Stock Trade restricted?
faqs.a: The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

bottomLine: Tesla Stock Trade reads as a functioning AI trading service with the standard package, and the product itself clears the bar for a cautious trial.
We rate it 4.6 with conditions: the platform is usable, the published claims are not all verifiable, and the US$250 minimum is the right size for testing either.
